entrance.name: Cellar stair
entrance.look: A stair of dressed stone beside the nave wall, half hidden under fallen plaster. The smell of earth is stronger here.
entrance.go_fail: The nave still crawls with rats. I will not go down among them.

do.say: Cold, and dry as a bone, and older than the house above it.

interact.look: Straw packing, trodden flat. Deep gouges run across the flags from the stair toward the cart door: the boxes were dragged this way.
Wine racks, long empty. In one the dust is disturbed where a hand has searched, and not so long ago.
A jar of lamp oil, half full, left by whoever lit this place.
interact.take_text: A half-jar of lamp oil. It will burn, and burning is half of what must be done here.

interact.look: Packing crates, split and empty. Scraps of paper cling to the straw.

do.say: Half-torn labels in a clerk's hand. Whoever sent these boxes did not think anyone would trace them.
